prompt: The chart below shows the reasons given by undergraduate and postgraduate international students for choosing to study in New Zealand in 2022.

visuals.title: Reasons for choosing New Zealand as a study destination, 2022
categories: Friends or family already living there

model:
The bar chart illustrates the percentage of undergraduate and postgraduate international students who gave six different reasons for choosing New Zealand as a study destination in 2022.

Overall, the quality and reputation of the country's universities was the most frequently cited reason for both groups. Undergraduates placed greater emphasis on safety and the English-language environment, while postgraduates were far more motivated by work prospects after graduation.

University quality was mentioned by 74% of postgraduates and 68% of undergraduates. For undergraduates, the next most common reasons were safety and political stability (61%) and the chance to live in an English-speaking environment (55%); the corresponding figures for postgraduates were noticeably lower, at 52% and 38% respectively.

The most striking difference concerned post-study work opportunities, which were cited by 63% of postgraduates, making this their second most important factor, but by only 42% of undergraduates. Cost was also a greater concern for postgraduates (41%) than for undergraduates (34%). Finally, having friends or family already in New Zealand was the least influential factor for both groups, though it mattered more to undergraduates, at 29%, than to postgraduates, at just 17%.
